notes: The bare «محمد» (no nasab in the text) is kept as written; it is the second «محمد» of the text, the one after «قال حدثنا».
«قال محمد فقلت لشعبة أليس في الحديث» is a question about the wording, and Shu'ba's answer («أظنها معها») is a doubt about wording: no new route.
«سمعت أوسا يقول» makes أوسا the Companion who speaks; the Prophet is the end.
